summary: Made and shipped long video L-20261019-01, 'Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 card: the real cost' (4:44, 60 beats, 977 words, 5 chapters), from Scout's top feed topic. Its trailer Short was blocked by the Shorts category rule and marked failed.
why: 0 of 3 long videos this week; the first usable high-priority feed topic was the card minimum-payment trap. Number check passed first time, the fact review passed first time (Fed G.19 APR ~22%, Reg Z minimum-payment and 36-month disclosures confirmed), and QA passed on the second re-render (liveliness 1.67, layout clean, audio peak -1.0 dB, mean -17.3 dB).

findings.title: First render failed the layout gate
findings.detail: The push camera on the screen beat zoomed its title 'Minimum only' out of the frame at 1:49. Switched to drift; logged as a scene item.

findings.title: QA failed the second render
findings.detail: No figure on frame 0 (a stage chip at 'start' still animates in) and the card prop covered Rohan's face on thumbnail C. Opened on a bignumber with the balance and minimum due drawn from frame 0, and gave thumbnail C a worried pose with no prop; QA passed.

findings.title: Long-form script rules applied
findings.detail: A concrete moment in the first beat (the card app, minimum due on screen), the promise line at ~20 s (how long, how much, the line that fixes it), and the side-by-side reveal at ~63% of the runtime.

findings.title: Trailer Short blocked
findings.detail: v-20261019-04 failed check-plan twice: credit_card was used in the last 3 Shorts (v-20261019-02). Marked failed; owner question raised on Notifications.

findings.title: check-plan still wants #Shorts on long videos
findings.detail: Same known bug as 2026-10-18 (already in the long-form backlog); shipped without #Shorts on purpose.

changes.title: Video L-20261019-01 committed to main
changes.detail: Commit c111fc2; mp4 on branch media/L-20261019-01 for the release workflow. Three thumbnails: number (main), question, warning (no angle data yet in evaluate).
